data.one_liner: Composable scrollable views that constrain size to parent constraints
data.what_it_does: Provides ConstrainedScrollView, ScrollableColumn, and ScrollableRow widgets that wrap standard scroll views with a LayoutBuilder to enforce minimum width/height. They allow scrolling content while respecting the parent’s constraints.
use_when: You need a scrollable area that adapts to available space
You want a simple column or row that scrolls when content overflows
You prefer a declarative widget over manual ScrollView setup
avoid_when: You need advanced scrolling features like slivers or custom physics
You require complex layout logic beyond simple constraints
data.minimal_example:
ConstrainedScrollView(
  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
  constraintsBuilder: (c) => BoxConstraints(minWidth: c.maxWidth, minHeight: c.maxHeight),
  child: const Center(child: Text('ScrollView value')),
)
